title: Analytic: high-Q Bragg-mirror microcavity, Q vs mirror pairs (FDFD eigenfrequency)
description:
A half-wave defect between two quarter-wave Bragg mirrors (N_pairs high / low index pairs each side, high index next to the defect, low index facing the vacuum), y-periodic strip with CPML along x, solved by the eigenfrequency study (em_fdfd_ez) on the cpu backend with host SuperLU. The sweep runs N_pairs over 3-12, which takes Q from ~2e2 to ~1e9: a test of how well the eigen solve and the PML resolve a tiny Im omega (the mirror leakage falls like rho^(-2 N)).
Design exact on the Yee grid: uniform h = 5 nm cells, every interface on a cell edge, and the indices chosen so the layers are discrete quarter waves at lambda0 = 1550 nm: n_i = sin(pi / (4 N_i)) / s0, s0 = pi h / lambda0 (N_H = 22, N_L = 53 cells: n_H 3.52, n_L 1.46; defect 2 N_L cells of n_L = a discrete half wave). On the grid each layer is then exactly a transmission line of phase K N h and admittance Y = tan(K h / 2) (E_z of the two cells beside a face continue each other's wave), so the resonance sits at lambda0 and the closed form below is the grid-exact pole to first order in Im omega (the next Im term is ~ 1 / Q^2 relative).
Analytic (exp(+j omega t)): mirror input admittance Y_in = rho^(2N) Y_0, rho = Y_H / Y_L, so the defect-side reflectance R = ((1 - b) / (1 + b))^2 with b = Y_L / Y_in, and Q = omega0 tau / (-ln R), tau = one-way cavity delay 2 N_C tan(pi / (2 N_C)) / omega0 plus the mirror reflection delay (finite-N quarter-wave stack sum, parameter tau_mirror; Babic-Corzine penetration depth in the continuum limit). Re lambda is lambda0 up to ~ 1 / Q^2.
Sweep tab: lambda_1 and Q_1 (row 0 of em.resonances) vs N_pairs with the dashed exact references (plot Q_1 on a log axis); the extra dashed curve Q_continuum on Q_1 is the same formula with continuum quarter waves (Y ~ n), which drifts from the grid-exact Q by ~0.1 % per pair (rho^(2N) of the discrete admittances). pml_1 = the resonance's share of |E_z|^2 in the PML. leak_1 = its share in the two vacuum gaps (resonance_table region gap_left + gap_right, column region_energy_fraction; the PML lies outside them) against f_leak_exact: E_z has nodes on the defect faces, its amplitude falls by 1 / rho per pair, every half / quarter wave sums to exactly N / 2 cells on the grid, and the outgoing wave in the gaps has amplitude rho^-N / u_0, so the share falls from ~6e-2 at 3 pairs to ~8e-9 at 12 by rho^-2 per pair, as 1 / Q does (plot on a log axis: Q_1 x leak_1 ~ constant). A mode confined to the defect lands on it over the whole sweep; a mirror band-edge or PML mode puts a share of order 1 in the gaps. Tolerance 3e-2, set by 3 pairs (Q ~ 2e2): the leaky growth of |E_z|^2 across the gap (k0 gap / Q, ~1 % on average), the first-order leakage terms (~2 b) and the CPML ripple (~2 |r_pml|); from ~5 pairs on the agreement should be well inside 1e-2.
The target sits target_offset (2e-4 relative, ~0.3 nm) beside the resonance so the shift-invert factor is not near-singular; set target_offset to 0 to test the shift right on a 1e9-Q pole.
Expected agreement: lambda_1 ~1e-7 (float32 permittivity), Q_1 limited by the CPML reflection (~2 |r_pml| relative, flat in N_pairs; tolerance 2e-3). A Q error that grows with N_pairs points at the eigen solve, not the PML. GPU: set solver_defaults backend 'gpu' and the eigen_solver factorization 'GPU cuDSS' (needs nvmath-python); 'GPU cuDSS, mixed precision' (float32 factor + refinement) is the stress case at large N_pairs.
Field tab: the Snapshot slider shows each resonance (|E_z| decays into both mirrors).

parameters.name: N_pairs
parameters.description: high / low index pairs of each mirror (swept)

parameters.name: N_H
parameters.description: cells per high-index layer (a discrete quarter wave)

parameters.name: N_L
parameters.description: cells per low-index layer (a discrete quarter wave)

parameters.name: N_C
parameters.description: cells of the low-index defect (a discrete half wave)

parameters.name: n_H
parameters.description: high index: discrete quarter wave in N_H cells at lambda0 (3.52)

parameters.name: n_L
parameters.description: low index: discrete quarter wave in N_L cells at lambda0 (1.46)

parameters.name: gap
parameters.description: vacuum between mirror and PML on each side (200 cells)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain length (cpml on both x faces)

parameters.name: target_offset
parameters.description: relative offset of the eigen target from lambda0 (0 = shift on the pole)

parameters.name: Y_H
parameters.description: discrete admittance tan(K h / 2) of the high-index layers (x h / 2)

parameters.name: Y_L
parameters.description: discrete admittance of the low-index layers and the defect

parameters.name: d_H
parameters.description: omega0 d(K_H N_H h)/d omega (pi/2 in the continuum)

parameters.name: psi_N
parameters.description: omega0 d(arg Y_in)/d omega of the mirror

parameters.name: tau_cavity
parameters.description: omega0 x one-way defect delay (pi in the continuum)

parameters.name: cells_mirrors
parameters.description: sum |E_z|^2 of both mirrors in defect-peak cells (pair m: amplitude rho^-m, N/2 per layer)

parameters.name: cells_vacuum
parameters.description: sum |E_z|^2 of both vacuum gaps (outgoing wave of amplitude rho^-N / u_0)

parameters.name: f_leak_exact
parameters.description: share of |E_z|^2 dA in the vacuum gaps (6e-2 at 3 pairs to 8e-9 at 12: x rho^-2 per pair, like 1 / Q)
